scripts.build: npm run build -w @callwave/config && npm run build -w @callwave/shared && npm run build -w @callwave/database && npm run build -w @callwave/redis && npm run build -w @callwave/rabbitmq && npm run build -w audio-calls && npm run build -w background-processes && npm run build -w user-management && npm run build -w video-calls
scripts.dev: concurrently -n users,audio,video,worker "npm run dev -w user-management" "npm run dev -w audio-calls" "npm run dev -w video-calls" "npm run dev -w background-processes"
scripts.start: concurrently -n users,audio,video,worker "npm run start -w user-management" "npm run start -w audio-calls" "npm run start -w video-calls" "npm run start -w background-processes"
